+            rep.fail(f"{path}.SPDXID", f"invalid SPDX ID {p['SPDXID']!r}")

+            rep.fail(f"{path}.name", "required field missing")
+        if "downloadLocation" not in p:
+            rep.fail(f"{path}.downloadLocation", "required field missing (may be NOASSERTION)")
+        if "filesAnalyzed" not in p:
+            rep.fail(f"{path}.filesAnalyzed", "required field missing")
+        if "licenseConcluded" not in p:
+            rep.fail(f"{path}.licenseConcluded", "required field missing (may be NOASSERTION)")
+        if "licenseDeclared" not in p:
+            rep.fail(f"{path}.licenseDeclared", "required field missing (may be NOASSERTION)")

+                     "must NOT be present when filesAnalyzed is false")

+            valid_checksum(f"{path}.checksums[{fi}]", c.get("algorithm"), c.get("checksumValue"), rep)

+            rep.fail(f"{path}.fileName", "required field missing")

+            rep.fail(f"{path}.SPDXID", f"invalid SPDX ID {f['SPDXID']!r}")

+            for pfe in ev.get("packageFileEvidence", []):
+                if pfe.get("fileName") not in (None, f.get("fileName")):
+                    rep.warn(f"{path}.evidence.packageFileEvidence",
+                             f"evidence fileName {pfe.get('fileName')!r} != component")
+                for c in pfe.get("fileChecksums", []):
+                    algo = c.get("algorithm")
+                    actual = {"SHA1": hashlib.sha1(data).hexdigest(),
+                              "SHA256": hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()}.get(algo)
+                    if actual and c.get("checksumValue") != actual:
+                        rep.fail(f"{path}.evidence.packageFileEvidence({algo})",
+                                 "evidence checksum mismatch vs disk")
+            for le in ev.get("licenseEvidence", []):
+                loc = (le.get("evidenceLocation") or "").lstrip("./")
+                try:
+                    etext = open(loc, encoding="utf-8").read()
+                except OSError:
+                    rep.fail(f"{path}.evidence.licenseEvidence.evidenceLocation",
+                             f"evidence location {loc!r} does not exist on disk")
+                    continue
+                lic = (le.get("spdxExtractedLicense") or {}).get("licenseId", "")
+                if lic and lic not in etext:
+                    rep.fail(f"{path}.evidence.licenseEvidence",
+                             f"license {lic!r} text not present in evidence location {loc!r}")

+    # ---- relationships ----
+    for ri, r in enumerate(doc.get("relationships", [])):
+        path = f"relationships[{ri}]"
+        for field in ("spdxElementId", "relationshipType", "relatedSpdxElement"):
+            if not r.get(field):
+                rep.fail(f"{path}.{field}", "required field missing")
+        if r.get("relationshipType") not in RELATIONSHIP_TYPES:
+            rep.fail(f"{path}.relationshipType", f"unknown type {r.get('relationshipType')!r}")
+        for ref in ("spdxElementId", "relatedSpdxElement"):
+            if r.get(ref) and r[ref] not in all_ids:
+                rep.fail(f"{path}.{ref}", f"dangling reference {r[ref]!r}")

+    # ---- hasFiles vs files ----
+    file_ids = {f.get("SPDXID") for f in files}
+    for p in packages:
+        for hf in p.get("hasFiles", []):
+            if hf not in file_ids:
+                rep.fail(f"packages[0].hasFiles", f"references unknown SPDXID {hf!r}")

+        path = f"hasExtractedLicensingInfos[{oi}]"
+        if not o.get("licenseId"):
+            rep.fail(f"{path}.licenseId", "required field missing")
+        if not o.get("extractedText"):
+            rep.fail(f"{path}.extractedText", "required field missing")
+        if o.get("licenseId") in SPDX_LIST_LICENSES:
+            rep.warn(f"{path}.licenseId",
+                     f"{o['licenseId']} is on the SPDX License List; "
+                     "hasExtractedLicensingInfos should only hold non-list licenses")
+
+    # ---- document describes ----
+    has_describes = any(
+        r.get("relationshipType") == "DESCRIBES" and r.get("spdxElementId") == "SPDXRef-DOCUMENT"
+        for r in doc.get("relationships", [])
+    ) or bool(doc.get("documentDescribes"))
+    if not has_describes and (packages or files):
+        rep.warn("document", "no DESCRIBES relationship or documentDescribes pointing at content")
+

+

+def main():
+    doc = json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))
+    rep = validate(doc)
+    rep.print()
+    sys.exit(1 if rep.fails else 0)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
